Landing.title: quickdraw
Landing.tagline: The realtime fullstack starter for quickdraw-core
Landing.subtitle: Typed Socket.IO services, two-tier access control, a full auth suite, and a multiplayer game foundation — already wired together. Fork it and build the interesting part.
Landing.featRealtimeDesc: Request/response methods, live subscriptions, and fire-and-forget channels over Socket.IO — end-to-end typed, zod-validated, cached with TanStack Query.
Landing.featAclDesc: Service-level roles plus per-entry ACLs (JSON or membership tables), enforced server-side on every method, subscription, and channel.
Landing.featGameDesc: A Godot 4 snake demo with real netcode: 20Hz input channels, client prediction, snapshot interpolation, server-side NPCs, and React overlays driving the sim.
Landing.featAuthDesc: Google & Discord OAuth, revocable sessions, guest play, a Discord Activity embed — and a mock OAuth flow so local dev never needs real credentials.
Landing.featAdminDesc: Every service gets an admin CRUD surface for free — the game's live-tunable variables are edited right in the browser.
Landing.featTestingDesc: Integration tests run on in-memory PGlite locally (seconds, no setup) and real PostgreSQL in CI — the same suite, both places.
Landing.featDeployDesc: GitHub Actions for drift checks, lint, types, and sharded tests, plus a one-click deploy pipeline to Cloud Run and Vercel.
Landing.featForkDesc: init-fork.sh renames the whole identity — app, database, deploy targets — and can carve out the game foundation cleanly if you don't need it.
Landing.quickStartTitle: Zero to realtime in four commands
Landing.quickStartForkHint: # then make it yours — one script renames everything:
Landing.footerNote: MIT licensed. Fork it and go.
